name: UniMate (preview)
description: UniMate (SIGGRAPH Asia 2026): one model that animates diverse skeletons from text. Driven here on a Mixamo humanoid skeleton.

code.install: Clone 'https://github.com/Friedrich-M/UniMate' into <ComfyUI>/models/text_to_motion/code/UniMate, install its inference dependencies into ComfyUI's Python ('pip install torchdiffeq einops transformers sentencepiece tyro accelerate loguru'), download the checkpoint folder with 'hf download Linzhan/UniMate --local-dir <ComfyUI>/models/text_to_motion/UniMate', and put the Mixamo skeleton features (dataset/features/mixamo, made by UniMate's data_process pipeline) into <ComfyUI>/models/text_to_motion/UniMate/features/mixamo. Restart ComfyUI. See docs/VNCCS_POSE_STUDIO_TEXT_TO_MOTION.md.

requirements.notes: Preview checkpoints. Text-only and limited to one 60-frame (2 s) window at 30 fps; Pose Studio applies the movement on top of the current pose. Only joint positions are generated, so hands, feet and head keep their start orientation. Set options.object_type to choose which Mixamo skeleton is used (default: the first one in the features).

guide.summary: Research preview (SIGGRAPH Asia 2026). Short clips of at most 2 s, joint positions only; cannot start from your pose.
guide.best_for: Trying the newest research model on short actions
guide.setup_effort: Expert: needs a code checkout and skeleton features built with UniMate's data pipeline

setup.label: UniMate code
setup.detail: Clone the repository into ComfyUI's models folder. Run the command from the ComfyUI folder. Do not install its requirements.txt: it pins torch, Blender and other packages that would break ComfyUI.

setup.label: Checkpoint (Linzhan/UniMate)
setup.detail: Downloads config.json, dataset_stats.npy and the newest checkpoint from Hugging Face into models/text_to_motion/UniMate.

setup.label: Mixamo skeleton features
setup.detail: UniMate takes its skeleton from preprocessed features. Build dataset/features/mixamo with UniMate's data_process pipeline and copy that folder to models/text_to_motion/UniMate/features/mixamo.
